brief: Wayfindr AI Support Assist conversation and account admin screens with preparing, ready, stale, unavailable states

displayed_order.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality product design board for one coherent direction named "Conversation rail" for Wayfindr, an existing self-hosted support desk web application. This is ONE design direction shown across two companion screens and their states, not multiple alternate ideas.
TARGET: 3072 x 2304 landscape design review board. Top row: two equally sized full desktop app screenshots each at natural 1440 x 1024 aspect, conversation workspace on the left and account admin AI connection on the right. Beneath, show a 4-column matrix of cropped state details: agent states in first row, admin connection states in second row. Keep typography readable, all content within canvas, no browser/device chrome. Board title short, screen titles clear. Each full screenshot has one primary task, not an inventory.

Use the existing Wayfindr design system exactly: IBM Plex Sans for interface, IBM Plex Sans Condensed for page headings, IBM Plex Mono only for support codes/model IDs. Paper #F1F1EE, white surfaces #FFFFFF, ink #16181A, muted #63676A, rules #DCDCD6, 2px corner radii, compact disciplined Bauhaus layout. Primary buttons nearly black with white text; teal #0D6F68 only site identity and selected navigation. Status green #1E7A4C, amber #C98A06, red #C3352B only small state indicators with text labels. No gradients, ornament, rounded bubble cards, glossy effects, mascot, or purple AI sparkle. Group with whitespace and dividers before borders; avoid nested cards. Desktop UI body target14–16px at each natural screenshot size.

CONVERSATION screenshot: existing narrow app rail on far left with Wayfindr wordmark then Desk, Tickets, Knowledge, Account. Top breadcrumb Desk / Harbor Supply / WF-DEMO42. Heading "Widget missing on checkout"; synthetic sample customer says "I added the widget yesterday, but it isn't showing on our checkout page." Main transcript is dominant, two calm messages and a clear empty normal reply composer below labelled "Your reply", primary black "Send reply". Never put Send inside Assist.
Persistent collapsible RIGHT RAIL width400px labelled "Assist", small green dot "Ready", subcopy "Private suggestions. You review and send." This rail has a short "Catch up" summary, then "Suggested reply" text: "Please confirm the checkout domain is on your site's allowed domains, then reload the page. If the widget still doesn't appear, send the page URL and any browser console error." One primary black action "Insert into reply"; secondary quiet "Refresh". Two source links "Install the widget" and "Allowed domains" labelled Published articles. Footer subtle "Includes latest message · just now". Do not show model selectors or fake confidence scores to the agent.

ADMIN screenshot: existing Account contextual sidebar, selected "AI Assist". Heading "AI connection" and subheading "For this account". Connection source single choice "Installation connection" or "Our connection" selected. A quiet single form: connection name "Support model"; provider "OpenAI-compatible"; model "support-model"; endpoint "https://models.example.test/v1"; API key masked with "Saved · replace to rotate"; helper "Custom endpoints follow your installation's access policy". Small green status "Connected · tested 10:40 AM". "Test connection" secondary plus black "Save connection". Small copy "Tests use sample text, never a customer conversation." Below divider, enabled switch "Prepare suggestions when a conversation opens", task checkboxes Summary / Reply draft / Relevant articles checked, site scope "Harbor Supply", usage limits disclosure. Distinguish connection/test from enabling automatic preparation. No customer messages in admin screen.

BOTTOM STATE DETAIL MATRIX must show exact four labelled columns Preparing / Ready / Stale / Unavailable, across both screen rows.
AGENT Preparing: "Preparing private suggestions…" "You can keep replying." skeleton lines, no fake output or insertion.
AGENT Ready: green small dot "Suggestions ready", excerpt, active "Insert into reply".
AGENT Stale: amber dot "New messages arrived", prior text still readable, "Refresh to include the latest message", disabled Insert, active Refresh.
AGENT Unavailable: small red dot "Assist is temporarily unavailable", "Keep replying normally", Try again, no raw provider error.
ADMIN Preparing: "Checking connection…" provider/model visible, "Using sample text", prevent duplicate Test.
ADMIN Ready: "Connected · tested 10:40 AM", "Saved credential", enablement shown separately.
ADMIN Stale: amber dot "Settings changed", "Test these settings again", "Saved connection remains active until you save", Test connection available.
ADMIN Unavailable: red dot "API key rejected", field-level explanation "Replace the key and test again", primary Test again, no key text.
Use current date October15,2026 America/New_York for any visible time. Label sample data discreetly on board. Realistic clear hierarchy, generous enough whitespace. No features beyond this brief.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality product design board for one coherent Wayfindr support application direction named "Reply workbench". Show ONE coherent design across two companion screens and requested states. This differs structurally from a conventional right rail: AI reply assistance sits directly alongside the reply composer in the lower workspace, while conversation context remains clean above.

TARGET3072x2304 landscape board. Top row contains two full desktop app screenshots, each natural1440x1024 aspect: conversation workspace left, account admin AI connection right. Bottom two rows are 4-column cropped state specimens, one row for agent Assist and one row for admin test/configuration. No device/browser chrome, no cut-off text, readable typography and real product density.

EXISTING WAYFINDR visual language: disciplined Bauhaus, IBM Plex Sans, Condensed headings, Mono identifiers. White #FFFFFF on paper #F1F1EE, ink #16181A, gray #63676A, thin #DCDCD6 rules.2px radii, black primary buttons, teal #0D6F68 only current site/nav. State dots with green #1E7A4C amber #C98A06 red #C3352B plus explicit labels. No purple gradients, sparkle, decorative cards, shadows, oversized rounding or marketing imagery.14–16px natural-screen body type. Group via spacing/dividers, not boxes-inside-boxes.

CONVERSATION full screen: compact left nav Wayfindr / Desk / Tickets / Knowledge / Account; breadcrumb Desk / Harbor Supply / WF-DEMO42. Heading "Widget missing on checkout". Upper60% focuses on transcript with realistic visitor/agent bubbles and a compact collapsible "Catch up" line under title: "Widget missing on checkout · Domain and console errors still needed". Synthetic customer message: "I added the widget yesterday, but it isn't showing on our checkout page."
Lower40% is a REPLY WORKBENCH split into editor left and Assist right within a unified flat surface. Editor label "Your reply", empty large textarea, primary black "Send reply" under editor. Assist label "Assist · Ready"; subline "Private suggestions. You review and send." Suggested response "Please confirm the checkout domain is on your site's allowed domains, then reload the page. If it still doesn't appear, send the page URL and any browser console error." Source links directly under related draft: Install the widget / Allowed domains. Primary action "Insert into reply" on Assist; secondary Refresh. A quiet "Improve my draft" action near editor, no automatic overwrite. Primary Send belongs to editor only. Sidebar details can be collapsed; don't invent a separate chatbot.

ADMIN full screen: Account contextual navigation left and "AI Assist" selected. "AI connection — for this account". Two functional columns in body: left narrow connection list with "Installation connection" and selected "Support model · Our connection"; right selected connection editor. Provider "OpenAI-compatible"; model "support-model"; endpoint "https://models.example.test/v1"; API key masked with "Saved credential". Small green dot "Connected · tested 10:40 AM". Secondary "Test connection", primary black "Save connection". Note "Test uses sample text, never customer data." Below a simple divider, account behavior "Prepare suggestions when a conversation opens" on; Summary / Reply draft / Relevant articles checked; site Harbor Supply enabled; Usage limits collapsible. Don't expose installation credential or customer transcript. Network policy help link is secondary.

BOTTOM STATE MATRIX four columns labelled Preparing / Ready / Stale / Unavailable; row labels Conversation Assist and Admin connection.
Agent preparing "Preparing private suggestions…" / "You can keep replying." Skeleton excerpt, editor stays usable.
Agent ready "Suggestions ready" source-backed excerpt and Insert into reply.
Agent stale amber "New messages arrived" / "Refresh to include the latest message." Old suggestion still readable, Insert disabled, Refresh active. Preserve composer content.
Agent unavailable "Assist is temporarily unavailable" / "Keep replying normally." Try again.
Admin preparing "Checking connection…" / "Using sample text." Provider/model visible.
Admin ready "Connected · tested 10:40 AM" with enablement separate.
Admin stale "Settings changed" / "Test these settings again." Helper "Saved connection remains active until you save."
Admin unavailable "API key rejected" / "Replace the key and test again." Test again. No secret material.
Anchor dates October15,2026 America/New_York. Use small discreet "Sample data" on board. This is a finished visual mockup, no annotations about implementation. Both screens and every requested state must be present and readable.

Use case: ui-mockup. Design a production-quality review board for ONE coherent Wayfindr interface direction named "Task tabs". It should show two companion screens and their four states, not alternate ideas. The distinctive structure is a quiet task-tab Assist panel and a straightforward single-column admin form. Keep the current Wayfindr style, not a new brand.

TARGET3072x2304 landscape. Top row: two desktop app screenshots, each natural1440x1024 aspect, conversation on left and AI connection admin on right. Bottom two rows: four columns of state detail crops for agent Assist and admin connection. Avoid cutoffs or tiny unreadable text. No browser/device bezel.

CURRENT DESIGN SYSTEM from source: IBM Plex Sans UI, IBM Plex Sans Condensed titles, IBM Plex Mono identifiers. White surfaces #FFFFFF, warm paper #F1F1EE, near-black #16181A, muted #63676A, thin rules #DCDCD6, square2px corners. Restrained teal #0D6F68 for site/nav only; black primary actions. Status green #1E7A4C, amber #C98A06, red #C3352B as small dots with text. No gradients, sparkle, mascots, decorative graphics, shadows or rounded nested cards. Body at14–16px at natural viewport. Whitespace then thin dividers, subtle tint only where functional.

CONVERSATION screenshot: narrow global nav left with Wayfindr wordmark and Desk / Tickets / Knowledge / Account. Heading "Widget missing on checkout", breadcrumb Desk / Harbor Supply / WF-DEMO42. Main transcript and empty normal composer remain dominant. Customer sample text "I added the widget yesterday, but it isn't showing on our checkout page." Normal composer "Your reply" and black "Send reply" always available.
A collapsible right Assist panel around400px wide. Heading "Assist" with small green "Ready". Subline "Private suggestions. You review and send." Compact tab row "Catch up" / "Reply" / "Sources", Reply active with black underline, not pill cards. Main tab shows source-backed draft "Please confirm the checkout domain is on your site's allowed domains, then reload the page. If the widget still doesn't appear, send the page URL and any browser console error." Small source chips "Install the widget" / "Allowed domains" but actual links not decorative badges. One primary black action "Insert into reply", quiet Refresh. Below brief info "Includes latest message · just now" and "How Assist uses this conversation" disclosure. Catch up tab exists for summary and Sources tab for full excerpts; don't show all feature sections at once.

ADMIN screenshot: use same shell with Account contextual sidebar, selected AI Assist. Title "AI connection", subtitle "For this account". Top single horizontal choice "Off" / "Installation connection" / "Our connection" with Our connection selected. A tidy SINGLE COLUMN form with label/value alignment: connection name Support model; provider OpenAI-compatible; model support-model; endpoint https://models.example.test/v1; masked API key with "Saved · replace to rotate". Subtle help "Custom endpoints follow your installation's access policy". Connection status separate from enablement: green dot "Connected · tested 10:40 AM"; "Tests use sample text, never customer conversations." Secondary Test connection and black Save connection. Second section after thin divider "Automatic preparation", one enabled switch "Prepare suggestions when a conversation opens", tasks Summary / Reply draft / Relevant articles enabled, Harbor Supply site selection and Usage limits disclosure. No plan/pricing cards, no model preference per agent, no operator secrets.

BOTTOM STATES: exact four column headers Preparing / Ready / Stale / Unavailable.
Agent preparing: "Preparing private suggestions…" "You can keep replying." Quiet skeleton, disabled insert, normal Send remains usable.
Agent ready: "Suggestions ready", draft excerpt, valid source links, active Insert into reply.
Agent stale: "New messages arrived", amber dot, "Refresh to include the latest message", previous output still visible, disabled Insert, active Refresh.
Agent unavailable: "Assist is temporarily unavailable", "Keep replying normally", Try again, no raw stack trace.
Admin preparing: "Checking connection…" "Using sample text" provider/model visible, no duplicate tests.
Admin ready: "Connected · tested 10:40 AM", Saved credential, separate automatic switch.
Admin stale: "Settings changed" "Test these settings again" "Saved connection remains active until you save."
Admin unavailable: "API key rejected" "Replace the key and test again" Test again, no exposed key.
Use date October15,2026 America/New_York for any visible timestamps and discreet Sample data label. All four states for BOTH surfaces required. This is one cohesive design direction.

revisions.reason: Remove the saved API-key eye/reveal affordance to match the write-only credential contract after PR #1179 review.
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: selected Wayfindr UI mock board repair.
Input image 1 is the edit target, not a style reference.
Primary request: make exactly one tiny correction to the existing image. In the TOP RIGHT account-admin AI connection screen, locate the API key field containing masked dots, with the adjacent text 'Saved · replace to rotate'. REMOVE the small eye/reveal icon at the far right INSIDE that masked API key field. Fill the icon's pixels with the same plain white input background so it reads as a saved-credential status field with NO reveal control. Keep the masked dots, field border, API key label, adjacent saved/replace text, helper text, and all other elements exactly unchanged.
Constraints: preserve the entire original board and its original landscape dimensions/aspect ratio; both full screens; conversation rail layout; account form layout; every text string; typography; colors; spacing; every Preparing, Ready, Stale and Unavailable specimen in both state rows; all buttons and source links. Do not crop, redraw, redesign, relocate or change any other content. No eye icon or reveal affordance may remain anywhere in the saved-credential field. This is a precise removal of one small UI icon, with no other changes.

revisions.reason: Replace the binary behavior toggle with visible Prepare when opened, Manual and Off choices, and add the separate Ticket details task for conversion while preserving write-only saved-credential status after PR #1179 review.
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: selected Wayfindr UI mock board repair, revision 3.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target.
Primary request: correct ONLY the behavior/tasks controls in the LOWER PART of the TOP RIGHT account-admin AI connection screenshot, below its connection/test divider. Replace the current binary switch and its 'Prepare suggestions when a conversation opens' heading/helper with a compact labeled 'Behavior' radio group showing all THREE choices at once: 'Prepare when opened' SELECTED, 'Manual' UNSELECTED, and 'Off' UNSELECTED. These must be visibly separate labeled radio choices, not a toggle or hidden dropdown.
Keep the checked Summary, Reply draft, and Relevant articles task checkboxes. Add one separate checked checkbox labeled exactly 'Ticket details', with adjacent smaller helper exactly 'On ticket conversion'. All FOUR task labels must be genuinely visible and readable. Keep Site scope / Harbor Supply and Usage limits beneath these task controls. Use compact spacing inside only this lower admin area to fit, preserving the current grouped single-form hierarchy and overall screen size.
Hard invariants: preserve the existing saved API-key masked-status field with NO eye icon, NO reveal icon, NO Show key affordance. Preserve the rest of the original image: entire landscape board dimensions/aspect ratio; both full screenshots; conversation right rail with Catch up, Suggested reply and Sources; normal composer and Send reply; connection-source radio choice, name/provider/model/endpoint/key fields, connection-test/save controls; every Preparing, Ready, Stale and Unavailable specimen in both bottom state rows; all text, colors, typography and layout outside the specific lower admin control region. No cropping, new screens, new tabs, redesign, or other added features.

revisions.reason: Replace installation-only usage disclosure with editable account request, token and concurrency limits, and represent write-only credential clearing and disconnect actions after PR #1179 review.
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: selected Wayfindr UI mock board repair, revision 4.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target.
Primary request: correct ONLY controls in the TOP RIGHT account-admin AI connection screenshot, preserving the selected Option 1 grouped form hierarchy.
1. In the usage-limits area BELOW the behavior/tasks divider, remove the installation-only explanatory text and Learn more link. Replace them with three clearly EDITABLE compact numeric input fields, each with a visible exact label and value: 'Daily requests' = '100'; 'Daily tokens' = '50000'; 'Concurrent calls' = '2'. Include the exact smaller helper 'Within installation limits'. All three labels, values and input borders must be readable and visible, not hidden in a disclosure. Compact spacing slightly inside this admin screen if needed to fit, keeping Site scope / Harbor Supply alongside or immediately before these usage controls below the task checkboxes. No cropping or cut-off text.
2. Beside the saved API-key masked-status field and its 'Saved · replace to rotate' status, add a small quiet text action labeled exactly 'Clear key'. Do NOT add an eye, reveal or Show key control.
3. Near the existing Test connection and Save connection actions, add a quiet text action labeled exactly 'Disconnect'. Preserve Test connection and Save connection as separate actions and retain the synthetic-test helper.
Hard invariants: preserve the entire landscape board's dimensions and aspect ratio; both full screenshots; conversation right rail with Catch up, Suggested reply, Sources, Insert into reply, Refresh and separate normal composer Send reply; account connection-source radio choices and provider/model/endpoint fields; the visible three-choice Behavior radios 'Prepare when opened' SELECTED, 'Manual', 'Off'; all FOUR checked tasks 'Summary', 'Reply draft', 'Relevant articles', 'Ticket details', and exact helper 'On ticket conversion'; Site scope control; no saved-key eye/reveal affordance. Preserve every Preparing, Ready, Stale and Unavailable specimen in BOTH bottom state rows, including all text, buttons and status labels. Keep existing restrained Wayfindr typography, colors and layout. No new screens, tabs, redesigned navigation, or other features.

revisions.reason: Make the bounded published-article passage-sharing disclosure visible beside Relevant articles and add the agent data-use disclosure entry point after comparing the selected mock with the current contract and plan during PR #1179 review.
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: selected Wayfindr UI mock board repair, revision 5.
Input image 1 is the exact v4 edit target.
Primary request: make TWO small disclosure corrections while preserving the entire selected Option 1 board.
1. In the TOP RIGHT account-admin screen, place a clear readable helper immediately associated with the checked 'Relevant articles' task. Exact helper: 'Selected, bounded published article passages are sent to the configured provider for grounded drafts.' This disclosure must be plainly visible beside or directly below the task row, not hidden behind a link, and make it clear that enabling articles shares selected article text with the configured provider. Use the space currently occupied by the redundant 'Automatically generate private suggestions for agents.' helper; reflow the task row/helper with compact spacing inside only this lower admin region so the disclosure and all lower controls remain readable and within the screenshot. Do not shrink the helper below the existing UI helper type size. Keep Site scope and usage controls below the tasks/disclosure.
2. In the TOP LEFT conversation screen, add one quiet visible text disclosure link labeled exactly 'How Assist uses this conversation' inside the Assist rail, above the existing included-message freshness footer. Keep the freshness footer in the rail. This is a disclosure entry point, not a model selector.
Hard invariants: preserve board dimensions/aspect ratio; both full screenshots; conversation transcript/composer dominance and vertically stacked Catch up / Suggested reply / Sources; Insert into reply and Refresh in Assist; Send reply in ordinary composer. Preserve account source radios, name/provider/model/endpoint fields, masked saved-credential status with Clear key and NO eye/reveal/Show key icon, Disconnect / Test connection / Save connection, and synthetic-test helper. Preserve ALL three Behavior radio choices: Prepare when opened selected, Manual, Off. Preserve ALL four checked tasks: Summary, Reply draft, Relevant articles, Ticket details, including 'On ticket conversion'. Preserve Site scope / Harbor Supply. Preserve the three EDITABLE usage inputs and values: Daily requests 100, Daily tokens 50000, Concurrent calls 2, plus 'Within installation limits'. Preserve every Preparing / Ready / Stale / Unavailable specimen in BOTH bottom state rows (eight specimens), with all status text and actions. No cropping, cut-off text, navigation changes, new screens/tabs, gradients, or other features. Keep existing Wayfindr typography, restrained colors and grouped form hierarchy.
